novels.title: Heaven’s Shadow
novels.description:
The world is made up of the five elements, and it could be divided into Yin and Yang.

Beneath the heavens, on the ancient divine center continent, billions of lives thrive in the prosperous era of the cultivation.

Across its vast lands, happiness, sadness, reunion, and separation played out in the long lives of those seeking immortalhood.

Light is always accompanied by darkness, and under the radiance of the heavens, there are silent shadows moving about…

novels.author: Vallabha
novels.title: Shadows of Deception
novels.description:
In a world where memories can be stolen and minds manipulated,
Shadows of Deception
follows Ethan Blackwood, a haunted ex-intelligence operative drawn back into a deadly web of espionage. Tasked with finding a missing neuroscientist, Ethan uncovers a conspiracy that stretches from high-tech labs to global powerhouses. With Dr. Isabella Martinez, a genius with secrets of her own, and Agent Sarah Thompson, relentless in her pursuit of justice, they race against time to stop Victor Kane—a tech mogul with ambitions that could enslave humanity’s free will. Betrayals run deep, alliances are fragile, and the truth is darker than anyone imagined.
Trust no one. Remember nothing. Survive everything.

novels.author: Diqllo
novels.title: Shadows of memories
novels.description:
In Lumnis, a city where the rain never truly dries and where neon lights conceal the most precious secrets, Elysia survives by stealing memories. Not the grand dramas just snippets of forgotten happiness, flashes of nostalgia that she sells on the black market for a few coins. Until the night she steals a fragment sealed in pulsing cyan blue, marked with a crimson seal.The touch burns. The world turns upside down.

At her side appears Kael, a young man with silver eyes who seems to be made of light as much as flesh. He tells her only one thing: she should never have touched that object. For the fragment is not merely a relic of memory it is a key. A key that faceless shadows have been hunting for centuries, and that a hooded figure, perched on the rooftops, seems to have finally found.

Pursued through the labyrinths of Lumnis, Elysia feels the fragment awaken in her palm. It shows her visions that are not her own: a young girl with her face, broken promises, a forgotten war for control of reality itself. The deeper she delves into this pursuit, the more the line between her memories and those of the fragment blurs. And Kael, who guides her while hiding his own secrets, seems to be the only one who understands the true cost of what she carries.

But in Lumnis, every memory comes at a price. And Elysia’s has just been paid.

novels.author: miracle_narrator
novels.title: SHADOW BEFORE CREATION
novels.description:
What if you were given the chance to travel…
not to one world, but to countless worlds?
Worlds where light and darkness clash, where mercy and cruelty walk side by side.
This is what happened to Arthur Narin.
An assassin who spent his life drenched in blood and betrayal, knowing nothing but killing and survival.
Until one ordinary day, he found himself surrounded by enemies who had come to end him.
He did not run.
He did not tremble.
He smiled… and fought until his final breath.
But death was not the end.
It was the beginning.
From that moment on, his journey through other worlds began — a journey filled with pain, conflict
and choices that would determine whether he would remain the monster he once was…
or become something entirely different.

novels.title: Shadows of Redemption
novels.description: Dr. Elena Carter’s latest discovery—a strange artifact buried for centuries—draws her into a hidden world where fallen angels walk the earth as vampires. As she unravels the artifact’s secrets, Elena becomes the target of dangerous forces, including Theo, a mysterious vampire tasked with watching her. But as dark truths surface, Elena realizes she’s connected to this world in ways she never imagined—and some secrets were meant to stay buried.

novels.author: anthonytumia
novels.title: Shadows of Heliora
novels.description:
In an age where Earth has been forsaken, three distinct individuals awaken on the tidally locked world of Heliora: Miro, the Outsider; Theron, the Rebel; and Elena, the Diplomat. As they explore their enigmatic environment, they encounter a diverse array of intelligent beings with shared ancestry to humanity, each inhabiting unique ecosystems and societies.

On Heliora's dark side, a prosperous civilization flourishes under synthetic light and a carefully controlled climate. In stark contrast, the light side is a harsh, desolate wasteland where survival is a relentless battle. This disparity fuels tension and strife between the inhabitants of these polarized realms.

As Miro, Theron, and Elena delve deeper into the planet's history and customs, they become entangled in local conflicts and power struggles. They uncover a ploy by a malevolent alien world that is disseminating information, inciting rebellion among the oppressed laborers. The hostile planet seeks to weaken Heliora by exploiting its social divisions, with ambitions of invading and dominating the vulnerable world. During all of this, a desert messiah figure has emerged, and has built a fanatical following in the deserts of Solaris. They evade observation by Linkers by hiding in select pockets throughout the desert, originally appearing to be several separate groups, the movement is much bigger than expected.

novels.author: SKURUZI
novels.title: SHADOWS OF CARTHIA
novels.description: A dark philosophical novel set in a sentient digital city built to test human consciousness. Marcus wakes up with no memory, only to find that the world around him is scripted—and he may be a character in a story he never agreed to. As the city begins to rewrite itself, Marcus must face the terrifying question: what if free will is just part of the design?

novels.author: JPwrites
novels.title: Shadow Clone Sorcery
novels.description:
He who doesn't play well with others, plays with himself.

Lukas Zaun has been a thief, an assassin, a spy, an ambassador, the herald of a dragon god, and a demon lord's enforcer. And he did it all, sitting on the beach, watching the waves, and enjoying a cup of tea. That's the advantage of having clones.

Now, he wants to become an archmage and try his hand at godhood. It means he'll need to start from scratch in a new body and on a new world but that's no problem for someone who can be in several places simultaneously.

Pursuits of a lifetime mean little to a man who lives multiple days while others toil through one.

Posting Monday to Friday.

novels.author: StarLit_Epoch
novels.title: The Shadow Era
novels.description:
The Shadow Era
Long before kingdoms rose, before crowns were forged, and before history carved its first name into stone, the world was torn apart by a catastrophe known only as
the First Cataclysm
.
From the mysterious
Gates of Shadow
emerged an endless tide of demons born from an ancient force called
Shadow Energy
. Civilizations collapsed, heroes fell, and humanity stood on the edge of extinction. Salvation came only through one legendary warrior—
Kaginoko, the Shadow
—who mastered the very darkness that had destroyed the world and sealed it away at the cost of everything.
But darkness cannot be erased.
It can only wait.
Centuries later, the remnants of Shadow Energy have become part of the world itself. Demons continue to emerge from forgotten lands. Powerful
Shadowborns
wield the dangerous Essence of Shadow to fight them, while three great factions—
Imperium
,
Concord
, and
Genesis
—compete to shape humanity's future through strength, discipline, or evolution.
Beyond the battlefields lie forgotten ruins, ancient bloodlines, forbidden relics, and mysteries buried beneath history itself. Every faction seeks the truth hidden behind the Gates of Shadow, while whispers speak of Demon Lords, lost civilizations, and a power older than the darkness itself.
As the balance between mankind and demons begins to crumble once again, forgotten forces awaken beneath the world.
The Gates are stirring.
The demons are evolving.
The Shadowborns are becoming stronger.
And a new age is about to begin.
In a world where every battle carries the weight of extinction, where ancient powers slumber beneath ruined kingdoms, and where the line between humanity and darkness grows thinner with every generation...
The greatest war in history has yet to begin.

novels.genres: LitRPG,Progression,Post Apocalyptic,Anti-Hero Lead,Strategy,Action,Adventure,Fantasy,Sci-fi,Cultivation,Cyberpunk,Dystopia,Genetically Engineered,Grimdark,High Fantasy,Magic,Male Lead,Technologically Engineered
novels.title: Shadow Runner [LitRPG]
novels.description:
Adrian was born a couple hundred years too late to witness humans ruling the stars. The days of relentless scientific advancement are long gone. Humanity’s former cradle has become the birthplace of nightmares, so Adrian lives on a world far from Terra.

But Adrian has a secret. His eyes are failing him, and in this age, blindness means death. When the chance arrives to earn a couple quick credits for a new pair of cybernetic eyes, he jumps on it. Only, Adrian gets more than he bargained for. With a slew of gangs, corpos, and a ruthless scientist now on his tail, he needs to do his best to survive and keep their hands off the prototype tech stuck inside of his skull.

Oh, and his new eyes are making him see horrors beyond mortal comprehension, but no biggie… right?

Expect:

+ A world where sci-fi meets eldritch nightmares, and everyone is worse off

+ A determined MC who’s out to make life better

+ A unique cyberpunk/eldritch world

+Daily 2k+ chapters

What NOT to Expect:

- A story where MC has tons of plot armor

- A story where only the MC is capable of using his head

- Cardboard side characters
